# netbox_owner_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/users/ownergroup/):

> An owner group is a set of owners.

Requires NetBox v4.5.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_owner_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
  description = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the owner group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the owner group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `member_count` (Number) The number of member objects that refer to the owner group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_owner_group.example 1
```
